name: Mythic Stand Still (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
None shall pass.

Prerequisites: Combat Reflexes, Stand Still.

Benefit(s): When you successfully use the Stand Still feat to make a combat maneuver check to force a foe to stop moving, you may also deal melee damage to that foe with a natural or unarmed attack or a weapon you have in hand.
